recovery.name: Recovery Night
recovery.description: A formula designed to support the evening routine, with four selected actives playing complementary roles.
recovery.science: Built around 3 g of glycine, the amount explored in several small studies before bedtime, with encouraging results on some subjective sleep and next-day fatigue measures. L-theanine (200 mg), magnesium (120 mg) and lemon balm (300 mg) complete the formula. These results don’t guarantee an individual benefit.
recovery.precautions: Don’t exceed the indicated serving. Other supplements containing magnesium are taken into account in your protocol. If you take medication, are pregnant or have persistent sleep problems, ask a professional.

flight.name: Flight Reset
flight.description: A three-step nutritional protocol for long-haul travel: before the flight, during the flight and the first nights after arrival.
flight.science: Pre-flight: L-theanine, magnesium and B6. In flight: electrolytes with supporting ingredients. Post-flight: Prosomnial®, a pistachio extract naturally containing melatonin. The overall effectiveness of this protocol against jet lag is not established.
flight.precautions: Allergen: pistachio in the post-flight phase. Precautions apply to some serotonergic medications, sedatives and thyroid treatments. The three phases are not meant to be taken together.

micro.name: Essential Micronutrients
micro.description: A foundation formula bringing together six micronutrients chosen for their complementary physiological roles.
micro.reason: Your Nutrition & Digestion profile is complete. This daily base (vitamin D3, K2, magnesium, zinc, selenium, B12) structures your micronutrient coverage, without replacing a varied diet.
micro.science: Vitamin D contributes to normal muscle and immune function, B12 to normal energy metabolism, zinc and selenium to the protection of cells against oxidative stress. These are recognised physiological roles, not proof of a personal deficiency.
micro.precautions: Vitamin K and anticoagulant treatments: important precaution. Total intake of vitamin D, minerals and other micronutrients must stay consistent with your routine.
